translation: For several years, even the affairs of brush and ink I have rested, excusing myself by saying I am lazy in using the mind; in truth, it is that I cannot gather back the released mind, and how could I use the thinking mind? Formerly there was a method of self-cultivation called “sunning” (曬); now there is a method of self-cultivation called “rubbing” (揉). Both are methods completed by former people, with no words of invention and no record of the reality of evidence, so later people set them aside as the common talk of old men, and instead seek medicine from people and beg numina from plants and trees. Who would know that they are the spirit arts of shedding the body and changing the bones, and raising the dead and restoring life? Therefore I do not fear to set forth the doctrine in detail to display and promote it. Having already asked the way, if one follows and practices it, only then will one believe that my words are not mistaken; now I also preach by example for it.
